Order_ 14.12.2023 Order No. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

02.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

3. The petitioners are apprehending arrest in connection with Bada Bazar P.S. Case No. 441 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 2729 of 2023 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Berhampur for the alleged offence under Sections 120-B/272/273/420 of IPC and read with Sections 51/52/53/56/57/59/63 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
4. Learned State Counsel has produced the case diary, which reveals that there are no allegations as such against the petitioner no.1.
In so far as the petitioner No.2 is concerned, it is alleged that he was involved in adulteration of edible ghee and sale thereof in the open market being the owner of the factory.
There is no material to show that he was directly involved in the process of adulteration.

5. Having regard to the nature of accusations and the materials on record, while not being inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners, the ABLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the petitioners to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.

In such event, they shall be released on bail on such terms E. Rajashree vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 14 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146610668/
